name: Dreamer: Behavior Learning by Latent Imagination
name_zh: Dreamer 潜在想象轨迹强化学习
summary: Optimize policies and values on trajectories imagined within a learned latent world model.
summary_zh: 在学习得到的潜在动力学模型中展开想象轨迹，并反向传播以优化行为策略。
core_idea: Train actor/critic behaviors through imagined trajectories rather than planning every action only by search.
innovation: Improves data-efficiency for some partially observed visual control tasks using learned models.
limitations: Imagined rollouts can amplify model bias.
Clinical intervention decisions require separate prospective safety validation.

start_here.why: ICLR 2020 introduction of Dreamer policy optimization in imagination.
start_here.focus: Model imagination, actor-critic training, gradients through latent rollouts.

curation_note: Representative publication checked; recommendations are advisory and application-specific clinical claims require separate evidence.
